bundle.shortDescription: Katika — manage your Stem Player without depending on stemplayer.com
bundle.longDescription: Katika is a standalone desktop manager for the Kano Stem Player. Browse the device library, add tracks, and split songs into stems locally — all without going through Kano's web app or cloud.
